business_summary: T.O. Holdings CO.,LTD., through its subsidiaries, engages in the distribution of clothing, furniture, home appliances, household appliances, food products, mobile phone agency, and credit card business in Japan and internationally. It also offers consumer loans; sells DIY supplies and food products; DVD / CD rentals, books/magazines, etc.; and timber, building materials, and plywood. In addition, the company is involved in civil engineering, pavement, and construction works, such as buildings and commercial facilities; leasing business of land and buildings, comprising apartments, detached houses, offices, warehouses, etc.; automobile sales and automobile repair business; and operation of sports clubs and swimming schools. Further, it engages in the provision of fire and automobile insurance, non-life insurance agency business, life insurance business, and leasing business, as well as selling and leasing office equipment, such as printers and multifunction devices, and mail order sales of office supplies and field supplies. Additionally, the company provides consultation services on new car sales, used car handling, inspection, maintenance, car sales, auto repair services catalogs, quotes, test drive search services, and car insurance consultations. The company was formerly known as T.O. Ogasawara Co., Ltd. and changed its name to T.O. Holdings Co.,Ltd. in June 2017. T.O. Holdings CO.,LTD. was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Hakodate, Japan.
